type A<T> = T extends unknown ? number : string;
const a: A<any> = "bad";
type B<T> = T extends any ? boolean : string;
const b: B<any> = "bad";
type U = unknown;
type C<T> = T extends U ? number : string;
const c: C<any> = "bad";
type D<T> = T extends string ? number : string;
const d: D<any> = true;
type E<T> = T extends unknown ? number : string;
const e: E<unknown> = "bad";
type G<T> = [T] extends [unknown] ? number : string;
const g: G<any> = "bad";
type H<T> = T extends infer U ? number : string;
const h: H<any> = "bad";
type I<T> = T extends {} ? number : string;
const i: I<unknown> = 1;
const i2: I<any> = true;
type J<T> = any extends T ? number : string;
const j: J<unknown> = "bad";
